cove.note: Made by tools/scale-model/tides/bake_tides.py from Scale Model 5.1 (h.png, wl.png). Read it with core/water/tide (KTIDE). eta(t) = sum_k A_k cos(w_k t - p_k) metres about mean sea level; t in seconds from the forcing epoch.

constituents.what: Giant libration and obliquity nod, Day conjunction wave

encoding.ph: u8 turn/256 (phase lag p in eta = A cos(w t - p))
encoding.grid: row-major nx x ny; cell (i, j) covers model px [x0 + i*cell, x0 + (i+1)*cell) x [y0 + j*cell, ...)
